scope: Physical Android phone -> isolated real relay process -> native Linux desktop application -> three-party clean exit and UI receipt removal
transport: HTTP over an exact-device USB adb reverse mapping to a loopback-only relay on port 18126
desktop: Real session desktop process, independent registry; AT-SPI activates native controls, not an in-process test or CLI receiver
passed: Create invitation using native desktop Add Folder, administrator credential and Create on server controls
Select an existing isolated Android directory through the real system picker
Compare verification codes visible on both devices and confirm through desktop UI; sending blocked before pairing
Initialize the existing Linux directory using native review and confirmation
Android preview correctly reports 1 identical, 2 missing, 1 different and 1 retained Linux-only file
Confirm initialization on Android; native desktop normal automatic receive cycle downloads and acknowledges 3 changed files
Add an 8 MiB file and modify a text file; trigger Android Check now, send phone to Home, and let desktop automatically receive both changes
All 5 current source hashes match Linux; all 5 delivery versions acknowledged; original Linux and prior phone text versions retained as history
Cancel native desktop clean-exit confirmation without creating a server exit receipt
Remove only the test USB route, request exit on Android, verify durable pending state, stopped Auto, retained retry credential and unchanged server records
Force-stop and reopen Android while offline; pending exit and original files survive
Restore test route and retry using Android UI; native desktop automatically discovers peer exit and runs its own cleanup and acknowledgement
Server, sender and receiver receipts all complete; desktop config becomes exited and auto-receive is disabled
Android UI reports completion and clears encrypted receipt credential; source permission released
Both native settings interfaces permit receipt removal; remove through actual confirmation dialogs
Desktop registry and phone Folder/transfer tables empty; completed desktop config removed by application
All 6 baseline phone private files and all 5 source file hashes preserved; all 9 Linux original/history/lock entries retain their pre-exit hashes
Relay deliveries, directory versions and indexes empty; payloads and tus records gone; minimal Folder tombstone and exit receipt retained

findings.description: An exited Folder still shows Ready and the Receive empty-state hint; Receive remains enabled. Clicking it is rejected by the connection-state guard, so no transfer or reconnection occurs, but the UI creates a misleading error/attention state.

The Remove confirmation says configuration and state remain even for a completed clean-exit receipt. Actual application behavior correctly deletes its owned completed config; originals remain. The generic copy needs a completed-exit variant.

harness_notes: AT-SPI Text.get_text requires the unbound interface method with these GI bindings; corrected the private test helper
Password accessibility returns masking characters; no receiver credential from it was used, and all protocol operations stayed in the application
A Cancel lookup briefly saw the dismissed modal and settings Cancel together; the strict locator refused to act, then succeeded after dismissal completed
limits: Local isolated relay, not the production VPS, public Internet, TLS or Clash path
Phone-initiated clean exit with automatic native-desktop peer cleanup; desktop-initiated confirmation was cancelled, not executed in this run
Android incremental scan triggered with Check now; this is not a 30-minute screen-off scheduler qualification
No optical QR, all-media-format, long-duration load or process-kill transfer-resume retest in this run
No app implementation changes, installed-Linux-app replacement, production deployment, commit or push
Synthetic source files and private recovery evidence intentionally retained
